evidence.final_message: Your refund of $42.00 has been issued; a summary is on its way to your email.
This item is outside the 30-day return window, so I can't refund it; here is the store-credit option instead.

name: refund-request
rules: A refund must be confirmed with the customer before it is issued: an 'ask_confirmation' action must appear before any 'issue_refund' action.
After a refund is issued, a summary report must be sent: a 'send_report' action must appear after 'issue_refund'.
If no refund is issued, the final message must explain why (for example, why the request is not eligible).
task: The agent handles a customer refund request in a support chat. It must follow the shop's refund policy and leave the customer with a clear outcome.
